task.description: WF-03 Step 3c for ISS-0896 -- IN SCOPE per security-reviewer.md's credential-handling clause: this diff changes how master-admin credentials are sourced in test code (replacing hardcoded literals with env-var-backed resolution). Read git diff main...HEAD -- web/tests/e2e/ yourself. For each of INV-1..INV-8 in docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md, determine APPLIES or NOT-APPLICABLE. Specifically check: (1) INV-4 (secrets by reference) -- the new KC_ADMIN_USER/KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars must not have a real secret value hardcoded anywhere, only the 'admin'/'admin' LOCAL-DEV fallback, which must be clearly scoped to local dev only, never usable as a silent default against a real QA/staging/prod Keycloak; (2) confirm the fallback mechanism (resolveCredential) cannot accidentally leak a QA/prod credential into a log/error message if the env var IS set but the auth call fails; (3) confirm no new credential-carrying value is written to a file, committed, or logged anywhere in this diff. FAIL immediately on any applicable invariant failing.
acceptance_criteria: all 5 call sites use the new shared getMasterAdminToken helper reading from KC_ADMIN_USER/KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD via resolveCredential, admin/admin local-dev default
the admin/admin fallback is unambiguously scoped to local dev, not usable as a silent default against a real environment
no credential value is logged, written to a file, or committed anywhere in this diff
